recipes.title: Rain on the Study Window
recipes.description: A complete 68 BPM beat with a stable hook and slowly breathing chords.
steps: Set tempo to **68 BPM**, root **D**, and a minor scale.
**T1:** choose **KUGO HARP**. Set GEN to **TURING**, **PROB 8**, and PATTERN **DIV 1/8**. On EVOLVE, click **ROLL** until the four- or eight-note loop feels unhurried.
**T2:** choose **STRING MACH**. Set GEN to **CHORD**, **PROG 2-5-1**, **BARS 2**, **HIT HOLD**; in the GEN sheet choose an open seventh voicing. Lower T2 in the MIXER.
**T3:** choose a warm bass sound. Set GEN to **EUCLID**, low density, then TWEAK **FOLLOW T2**; hold **OCT-** on TWEAK and set **HOW BASS**, **RHYTHM OWN**.
**T4:** choose **808 KIT**, GEN **ATLAS**, **DENS 42**. Hold **OCT-** on GEN and thin **HAT** to about 25. Add TWEAK **HUMAN 18**.
Put **ECHO** on T1 with a low mix. Route a slow **TIDE** to T2 cutoff, about +20%. Let it play for two minutes before touching anything.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute T1 for eight bars, hold **FILL** for the last bar, then bring the hook back.

recipes.title: Dust on the Needle
steps: Tempo **72 BPM**; choose a pentatonic or KUMOI scale.
**T1:** KOTO WARM, GEN **CONSTL**, **DENS 45**, **SPEED 1/16**. In the GEN sheet use **SIZE 2**; hold OCT- for **LEN 8**, **LOCK 80**.
Set LENGTH to **HIT**, then add TWEAK **DROP 20** so the gaps ring.
**T4:** ATLAS at **DENS 35**. Keep kick full, hats near 20, and set a rim as the fourth part at about 15.
Route a very slow **DRIFT** to T1 pan with a small amount and to FX send with an even smaller amount.
recipes.note: **Change it:** move CONSTL **Y** by a few clicks when a new eight-bar section begins.

recipes.title: Cassette Walk Home
steps: Tempo **76 BPM**, minor scale.
**T1:** a soft tine sound, GEN **SERIES**, **INTV 1**, **LOOP 8**, PATTERN **DIV 1/8**.
EVOLVE **EVERY 8** with a small amount so SERIES chooses a new starting place only occasionally.
**T2:** GLASS PAD, CHORD **PROG WALK**, **BARS 2**, **HIT HOLD**. Use QNT **CHRD** on T1 so the line follows the pad.
**T4:** ATLAS, DENS about 45, TWEAK **HUMAN 24** and TIMING **SPLIT 12**, **HOW PUSH**.
recipes.note: **Play it:** slowly raise T1 echo send during the walk, then cut it on the downbeat.

recipes.title: Sleepy Bus Ride
steps: Tempo **62 BPM**, E KUMOI.
**T1:** GEN **BOUNCE**, turn **BALLS** past four into **FALL**, **SPEED 12**. Keep WIND near the center.
Route **SWARM 3** to B ANGLE at about 20% so gusts arrive and fade.
**T2:** CHORD **PROG DRONE**, **HIT HOLD**, open voicing, one octave down; keep it very quiet.
**T4:** ATLAS at DENS 28, with sparse kick and rim, no busy hats.
recipes.note: **Change it:** LENGTH **HIT** on T1 makes each falling note smear into the next.

recipes.title: Bent Photograph
steps: Tempo **70 BPM**. Pick a seven-note minor scale.
**T1:** TURING, **PROB 0**, PATTERN LEN 7. Find a seed with ROLL.
EVOLVE **EVERY 4**, **AMOUNT 25**; hold OCT- and set **GRAVITY 65** so changes keep returning to the original photo.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, **SHIFT +2**, **DROP 55** for an incomplete upper harmony.
Pan the two voices apart and give only T2 a short echo.
recipes.note: **Change it:** FORM **AABA**, CONTR 20 turns the memory into four repeating scenes.

recipes.title: Coffee Shop Closing Time
steps: Tempo **74 BPM**, root C, major or major-pentatonic scale.
**T2:** CHORD **PROG POP**, **BARS 2**, **HIT BEAT**, with a soft electric-piano sound.
**T1:** MARKOV, **LEAP 20**, **DENS 48**, SCL **QNT CHRD**.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1 with HOW **BASS**, RHYTHM **SOURCE**, then DROP about 35.
**T4:** ATLAS around DENS 40; use FORM **ABAC**, CONTR 15, with EVOLVE EVERY 4.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute drums for the first pass of section C and unmute on its second chord.

recipes.title: VHS Sunset
steps: Tempo **64 BPM** and choose a bright scale against dark sounds.
**T1:** GLASS PAD through the **FILTER** effect, cutoff below halfway and a little resonance.
GEN **CHORD**, PROG **CIRCLE**, BARS 4, HIT HOLD, open voicing.
Route **TIDE 2** to the filter cutoff (+30%) and **SWARM 2** to pan (+12%).
**T3:** SERIES, LOOP 4, INTV 3, DIV 1/4, QNT CHRD; keep its level just above silence.
recipes.note: **Change it:** set PIECE to 8 minutes, **SHAPE FALL**, END LOOP for an endlessly fading sunset.

recipes.title: Wobbly Piano Loop
steps: Tempo **71 BPM**. Select the closest soft keys or tine preset.
**T1:** TURING, PROB 3, DIV 1/8, short eight-step phrase.
Put ECHO on FX 2. Route a slow LFO to echo time with a tiny amount; moving delay time supplies tape-like pitch bends.
Route another slow source to T1 pan at 8–12%.
**T4:** a dry ATLAS beat at DENS 38; the contrast makes the keys feel more unstable.
recipes.note: **Change it:** print the phrase by holding REC, then nudge two notes late on their step sheets.

recipes.title: Rooftop Homework
steps: Tempo **78 BPM**, minor pentatonic.
**T1:** ARP or TURING on a pluck, PATTERN DIV 1/16, TWEAK DROP 45 and HUMAN 15.
**T2:** CHORD PROG **2-5-1**, BARS 2, HIT HOLD, quiet and wide.
**T3:** a bass following T2 with HOW BASS; restrict it to beats 1 and 3.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 52, hats 35, fourth part RIM 20. Add a last-bar fill with COND 4:4.
recipes.note: **Play it:** use the four MIXER levels like a tiny desk—bring each part in over four bars.

recipes.title: Library After Dark
steps: Tempo **58 BPM**. Use a minor scale and low master levels.
**T1:** CONSTL, DENS 25, SPEED 1/16, SIZE 3, LEN 4, LOCK 90.
**T2:** a pad on CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD. Route TIDE 3 to cutoff.
**T3:** BOUNCE/FALL at SPEED 8, WIND slightly low; set DROP 50.
Skip drums. Route a tiny amount of SWARM to each track's pan, using different SWARM speeds.
recipes.note: **Change it:** add one isolated kick on every fourth bar; the silence around it is the groove.

recipes.title: Cracked Sidewalk Cypher
steps: Tempo **82 BPM**, minor scale.
**T4:** ATLAS, DENS 58. Keep kick 100, snare about 70, hats 28; HUMAN 20.
Add TIMING SPLIT 18 with HOW **PUSH** for occasional half-division hits.
**T1:** TURING bass, PROB 6, DIV 1/8, narrow range and short fixed notes.
**T2:** a sparse MARKOV stab at DENS 22, LEAP 10, with echo.
recipes.note: **Play it:** hold FILL at the end of every eight bars, but sometimes deliberately miss it.

recipes.title: Sunday Morning Tape
steps: Tempo **66 BPM**, major pentatonic.
**T1:** KUGO HARP, SERIES, INTV 1, LOOP 8, DIV 1/8, LENGTH HIT.
**T2:** STRING MACH, CHORD USER. Enter a simple I–vi–IV–V progression; BARS 2 and HIT HOLD.
Set T1 QNT CHRD. Add an LFO to its FX send so only some phrases bloom into echo.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 32, kick full, snare soft, hats sparse.
recipes.note: **Change it:** FORM AABA on T1 with low contrast; leave the chords unchanged.

recipes.title: Laundromat Fluorescence
steps: Tempo **75 BPM**, Dorian scale.
**T1:** POLY with rhythms /4, /5, and /7; SPAN 1 for a tight repeating chord fragment.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, low-pass it with FILTER.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 46. Route a 4BAR triangle LFO to AT X and a 2BAR triangle from another track to AT Y.
Keep FORM off: the interlocking cycles create the repeating machine pattern.
recipes.note: **Change it:** raise SPAN to 2 when you want the melody to escape the room.

recipes.title: Polaroid Summer
steps: Tempo **80 BPM**, a major scale.
**T1:** CONSTL DENS 55, SIZE 2, LEN 8, LOCK 75, FILL ARP.
**T2:** CHORD PROG POP, BARS 1, STRUM around 35 ms (**3.5+**), open voicing.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 48 with clap as its fourth part.
Put a modest echo on T1 and route TIDE to the echo mix, not the melody pitch.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute the chords for two bars and let the melody imply them.

recipes.title: Apartment Heater Groove
steps: Tempo **69 BPM**, any minor scale.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 38, FORM **AB**, EVERY 4, CONTR 10, LOCK 85.
Use the fourth part as RIM at about 18; thin hats to 15.
**T1:** TURING bass with a five-step pattern against the drums, PROB 0.
**T2:** a single CHORD DRONE with TIDE on cutoff, almost inaudible.
recipes.note: **Change it:** the five-step bass slipping against the four-bar drum form supplies all the arrangement you need.

recipes.title: Last Train Sketchbook
steps: Tempo **73 BPM**, harmonic-minor-like scale if available, otherwise minor.
**T1:** SERIES, INTV 3, LOOP OFF, DIV 1/8; use a bell or tine sound.
**T2:** CHORD WALK, BARS 2, HIT HOLD. Quantize T1 to CHRD.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW **CANON2**, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 60; pan it opposite T1.
**T4:** sparse ATLAS at DENS 30 with HUMAN 25.
recipes.note: **Change it:** use CHAIN ABAC, PHRASE 8; the endless SERIES line still gains recognizable chapters.

recipes.title: Notebook Margin Doodles
steps: Tempo **77 BPM**, KUMOI.
**T1:** AWAKE. Edit a simple A/B state pattern by selecting white keys and setting contrasting values.
PATTERN DIV 1/8; keep notes short and add TWEAK HUMAN 12.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1 at SHIFT +4, DROP 70, so only occasional doodles gain an answer.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 44, fourth part CLAP, hats low.
recipes.note: **Change it:** print the generator, then use STEP EVOLVE with AMOUNT 20 and GRAVITY high.

recipes.title: Fogged Cafe Glass
steps: Tempo **60 BPM**, minor scale.
**T1:** GLASS PAD, CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, through FILTER with cutoff low and resonance modest.
**T2:** MARKOV on a flute-like sound, DENS 25, LEAP 15, LENGTH HIT.
Route TIDE 2 to pad cutoff and TIDE 3 to melody FX send.
**T4:** only a low kick and rim: ATLAS DENS about 20, hats at zero or near zero.
recipes.note: **Play it:** turn the filter cutoff by hand once per minute; small movements feel enormous.

recipes.title: Unsent Voicemail
steps: Tempo **65 BPM**, a restrained minor scale.
Record a short melody into **T1 STEP**, leaving several empty steps.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1 with HOW **CANON4**, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT 0, DROP 35. Use a thinner sound and more echo.
On T1 use STEP EVOLVE EVERY 8, AMOUNT 15, HOW DRIFT; keep the original pattern recoverable.
No drums at first. Later add a kick only on beats 1 and 3.
recipes.note: **Change it:** mute T1; in 3.5+, the delayed follower continues and sounds like a message without its speaker.

recipes.title: Dawn Through Blinds
steps: Tempo **67 BPM**, root A, major pentatonic.
**T2:** CHORD USER with A–E–F♯m–D (enter roots in the active scale), BARS 2, STRUM 45 ms (**3.5+**).
**T1:** TURING, PROB 4, DIV 1/8, QNT CHRD; select a warm pluck.
**T3:** bass follower, HOW BASS, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 25.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 36. On PIECE choose 6 minutes, SHAPE RISE, END STOP.
recipes.note: **Play it:** assign a PERF macro to pad cutoff, drum density, and echo send; raise it as the light arrives.

recipes.title: Midnight Warehouse
steps: Set **132 BPM**, root F, minor scale.
**T4:** 808 KIT, GEN **ATLAS**, DENS 72. Keep kick at 100, snare around 55, hats 65. Find an X/Y position with a kick on every beat or print the pattern and place four kicks manually.
**T1:** a short bass sound, GEN **TURING**, PROB 0, DIV 1/16. Find a one- or two-note seed, then TWEAK DROP 30.
**T2:** a bright chord sound, GEN **CHORD**, PROG DRONE, BARS 1, HIT BEAT, with short LENGTH. Use a minor chord and offbeat rhythm.
Put FORM AB on drums, EVERY 8, CONTR 12. Keep section A dry; during B raise hats and echo send by hand.
recipes.note: **Drop:** mute T1 and T4 for one bar, let the chord echo hang, then unmute both on beat one.

recipes.title: Sandstorm Runner
recipes.description: A fast minor-key trance sketch built around motion, not a transcription of any existing song.
steps: Set **136 BPM**, E minor.
**T1:** choose a sharp lead, GEN **SERIES**, INTV 1, LOOP 8, PATTERN DIV 1/16. Use short fixed notes.
**T2:** a bass sound, GEN **EUCLID**, dense 1/16 rhythm; TWEAK FOLLOW T1, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN. Keep the range low.
**T3:** CHORD PROG DRONE, HIT BEAT, short notes on the offbeats; add a modest echo.
**T4:** four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on offbeats. STEP is easiest; ATLAS is livelier.
Route a slow rising source or PERF macro to T1 cutoff, T1 FX send, and drum density. Use MOD DEPTH as the build brake (**3.5+**).
recipes.note: **Build:** over 16 bars open the lead, increase note density, hold FILL in bar 16, then snap the macro back on the drop.

recipes.title: Neon Tunnel Trance
steps: Set **138 BPM**, A minor.
**T2:** CHORD USER; enter Am–F–C–G, BARS 1, STRUM 20 ms, HIT BEAT (**3.5+**).
**T1:** ARP or CONSTL, DIV 1/16, SCL QNT CHRD, tight range. Add echo with dotted-feeling repeats by ear.
**T3:** FOLLOW T2, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN; use a repeating offbeat pattern.
**T4:** solid kick each beat, clap on 2 and 4, open hat between beats.
recipes.note: **Change it:** CHAIN AABA, PHRASE 8. In B, shift the lead up one octave and thin the kick for four bars.

recipes.title: Acid Tile
steps: Set **128 BPM**, C minor.
**T1:** a resonant, bright sound through FILTER; GEN TURING, PROB 12, DIV 1/16, pattern length 7.
Use per-step accents and a few ties after printing the generator to STEP. Nudge one note early.
Route a 1BAR triangle LFO to FILTER cutoff and a slower TIDE to resonance with conservative amounts.
**T4:** dry four-on-the-floor drums. Add a clap fill with condition 4:4.
recipes.note: **Play it:** move the base cutoff by hand while modulation keeps the phrase alive.

recipes.title: Piano Rave Sunrise
steps: Set **126 BPM**, C major.
**T2:** a piano-like sound, CHORD USER; enter C–Am–F–G, BARS 1, HIT BEAT, open voicing.
**T1:** a bright pluck on FOLLOW T2, HOW CHORD, RHYTHM OWN; use a syncopated EUCLID rhythm.
**T3:** bass follower using HOW BASS, notes on the offbeats.
**T4:** kick every beat, clap on 2/4, bright open hat offbeat. Add HUMAN only to clap and hats, not the kick.
recipes.note: **Breakdown:** mute T3/T4, change chords to HIT HOLD, then restore HIT BEAT with the drums.

recipes.title: Detroit Night Drive
steps: Set **124 BPM**, D Dorian.
**T1:** POLY with /4, /5, and /7 rhythms, SPAN 1, using a muted synth sound.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE with a seventh, HIT HOLD; FILTER cutoff low, TIDE modulation subtle.
**T3:** SERIES bass, INTV 1, LOOP 4, DIV 1/8.
**T4:** minimal kick, clap, and shuffled hat pattern. Use TIMING SPLIT at 10–15 rather than heavy HUMAN.
recipes.note: **Change it:** route a 4BAR LFO to T1 pan and an 8BAR LFO to its FX send.

recipes.title: Breakbeat Basement
steps: Set **134 BPM**, minor scale.
**T4:** write a STEP drum pattern: broken kicks, snare on 2 and 4, 1/16 hats. Add one ghost snare with low chance.
Put ratchet x2 on two hats and nudge the last snare late.
**T1:** TURING bass, PROB 4, pattern LEN 5, DIV 1/8.
**T2:** short MARKOV stabs, DENS 25, LEAP 30, echo send high.
recipes.note: **Fill:** duplicate the drum pattern, rearrange the last four steps, and switch patterns for the final bar of a phrase.

recipes.title: Hypnotic Concrete
steps: Set **130 BPM**, one dark minor chord.
**T1:** TURING, PROB 0, LEN 5, one-octave range, DIV 1/16.
FORM AABA, EVERY 4, CONTR 8, DEVELOP 10. The motif changes less than the listener expects.
**T4:** four-on-the-floor ATLAS, DENS 60. Route a 4BAR triangle LFO to AT Y.
Use a PERF macro for FILTER cutoff, hat density, and FX send; never turn it past about two-thirds.
recipes.note: **Rule:** do not add a new part for five minutes. Arrange timbre and silence instead.

recipes.title: Eurodance Balcony
steps: Set **140 BPM**, G minor.
**T2:** CHORD USER with Gm–E♭–B♭–F, BARS 1, HIT BEAT, bright chord sound.
**T1:** SERIES lead, LOOP 8, INTV 2, DIV 1/8, QNT CHRD.
**T3:** bass follower, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN, offbeat pattern.
**T4:** kick each beat, clap on 2/4, open hats offbeat. Keep everything unapologetically bright.
recipes.note: **Change it:** shift T1 up an octave in section B and use ANSWER on a second lead for call-and-response.

recipes.title: Strobe Polyrhythm
steps: Set **128 BPM**, minor pentatonic.
**T1:** POLY rhythms /3, /4, /5, SPAN 2; short metallic notes.
**T2:** QUAD at DIV 8T while T1 runs 1/16; use a low percussive sound.
**T4:** straight four-on-the-floor kick anchors the conflicting cycles.
Route a square 2BAR LFO to T1 FX send, creating alternating dry/wet flashes.
recipes.note: **Change it:** Mute T1 for four bars. When it returns, the ear hears a new downbeat even though nothing moved.

recipes.title: Goa Constellation
steps: Set **142 BPM**, E KUMOI or another narrow exotic scale.
**T1:** CONSTL, DENS 75, SPEED 1/16, SIZE 3, LEN 8, LOCK 70, FILL ARP.
Set AUTO steering with a constant MODS offset around the middle; route SWARM to C Y.
**T2:** a low TURING line, PROB 5, DIV 1/16.
**T4:** driving kick and rolling hats. Use PIECE 8 min, SHAPE ARCH, END STOP.
recipes.note: **Build:** raise CONSTL SIZE and FILTER cutoff together; reduce both immediately before the peak kick returns.

recipes.title: Afterhours Dub Techno
steps: Set **122 BPM**, D minor.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE, seventh chord, HIT BEAT with short fixed length.
Put ECHO on the chord with a high feedback feel but moderate mix. Route TIDE 3 to FX send.
**T1:** bass on beats 1 and 3, following the chord with HOW BASS.
**T4:** deep kick each beat, rim on occasional offbeats, almost no hats.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute the chord itself while leaving its echo tail; bring in a new stab only after the old tail clears.

recipes.title: Tidal Glass
steps: Set **48 BPM**, E KUMOI.
**T1:** GLASS PAD, CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, open seventh voicing.
Route TIDE 1 to cutoff (+25%), TIDE 2 to pan (+12%), and TIDE 3 to FX send (+18%).
**T3:** BOUNCE in FALL mode, SPEED 8, WIND centered, LENGTH HIT.
Set PIECE to 12 minutes, SHAPE ARCH, END LOOP.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the point where the falling notes briefly imply a new chord over the unmoving drone.

recipes.title: Paper Lanterns
steps: Set **54 BPM**, major pentatonic.
**T1:** CONSTL, DENS 28, SPEED 1/16, SIZE 3, LEN 4, LOCK 80.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON4, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 45; use a softer sound.
Give both voices long LENGTH HIT notes and pan them apart.
Route different SWARM sources to their FX sends so their echoes rarely bloom together.
recipes.note: **Change it:** move CONSTL Y one click every few minutes.

recipes.title: Moss Radio
steps: Set **40 BPM**, a minor pentatonic scale.
**T1:** TURING, PROB 0, DIV 1/4. Find a three-note seed.
EVOLVE EVERY 8, AMOUNT 18, GRAVITY 80.
**T2:** a quiet CHORD DRONE one octave down; route TIDE to cutoff.
Add FILTER and ECHO to T1, both mostly dry.
recipes.note: **Rule:** if a modulation is immediately obvious, halve its amount.

recipes.title: Cloud Atlas
steps: Set **52 BPM**, D major.
**T1:** CHORD WALK, BARS 4, HIT HOLD, open voicing.
**T2:** MARKOV, DENS 20, LEAP 10, QNT CHRD, LENGTH HIT.
**T3:** SERIES, INTV 1, LOOP OFF, DIV 1/2, QNT CHRD.
Use ENTRIES around 35 so voices arrive and leave over long spans.
recipes.note: **Change it:** PIECE 20 minutes, SHAPE RISE, END LOOP makes each cycle return to open sky.

recipes.title: Frozen Lake Canon
steps: Set **45 BPM**, root C, suspended-feeling scale.
Record a sparse eight-note STEP melody on T1 with long notes.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON2, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT +4.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON8, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT -7.
Pan T2/T3 apart and use progressively more echo on each delay.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute T1 after one pass and let only its reflections remain.

recipes.title: Breathing Stone
steps: Set **35 BPM**, any minor scale.
**T1:** low CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, FILTER cutoff low.
**T2:** high CHORD DRONE, same root, a more open voicing, level very low.
Route one slow LFO upward to T1 cutoff and the inverted direction to T2 level.
Add SWARM to pan on both at less than 10%.
recipes.note: **Change it:** use a PERF macro as a manual breath, raising one layer while lowering the other.

recipes.title: Distant Weather
steps: Set **50 BPM**, KUMOI.
**T1:** BOUNCE/FALL, SPEED 6, WIND slowly modulated by SWARM 3.
**T2:** CONSTL, DENS 15, SIZE 4, LOCK 40, LENGTH HIT.
**T3:** CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, almost silent.
Route TIDE 2 to global-feeling FX sends and let the dry gaps remain long.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** accidental clusters. Do not fix the first dissonance; wait for its release.

recipes.title: Hour Hand
steps: Set **30 BPM**, one consonant scale.
**T1:** SERIES, INTV 1, LOOP OFF, DIV 1/2.
**T2:** POLY using /3 and /5 only, SPAN 1, very long notes.
**T3:** CHORD WALK, BARS 8, HIT HOLD.
Set PIECE to 60 minutes, SHAPE USER, with eight gently alternating energy points; END STOP.
recipes.note: **Rule:** save it, press PLAY, and leave the controls alone for the first ten minutes.

recipes.title: Crooked Pocket
steps: Set **92 BPM**, minor scale.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 58, kick 100, snare 65, hats 38.
Add TWEAK HUMAN 22 and TIMING SPLIT 14, HOW MIX.
**T1:** TURING bass, DIV 1/8, LEN 5, PROB 3.
**T2:** short chord stab only on condition 2:4 and 4:4.
recipes.note: **Change it:** remove one kick rather than adding more percussion.

recipes.title: Dub Courtyard
steps: Set **84 BPM**, D minor.
Write a sparse STEP kick/rim pattern on T4.
**T1:** bass on a short TURING loop, PROB 0, long enough notes to overlap the empty space.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE with short HIT length; send selected stabs into ECHO.
Route a slow LFO to echo time with a small amount and perform FX send by hand.
recipes.note: **Play it:** the echo is an instrument—send one stab, then leave room for its answer.

recipes.title: Five Against Four
steps: Set **100 BPM**, pentatonic scale.
**T1:** POLY with /4 and /5, SPAN 1.
**T2:** a bass STEP pattern of five steps at DIV 1/8.
**T4:** a conventional four-beat drum pattern.
FORM AB on drums only, EVERY 4, CONTR 12.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** where the bass appears to change even though its five steps never do.

recipes.title: Broken Robot
steps: Set **110 BPM**, minor scale.
**T4:** STEP drums with LEN 15. Put kicks on uneven gaps and snare near the expected backbeat.
Give two hats ratchet x2 and one hit a 50% chance.
**T1:** AWAKE with a rigid short sound; DIV 1/16.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1 at SHIFT +2, DROP 75, for occasional sparks.
recipes.note: **Change it:** DIR PEND on one melodic pattern makes the robot retrace its steps.

recipes.title: Atlas Cartographer
steps: Set **105 BPM**.
**T4:** ATLAS, DENS 62. Sync its LFO to 4BAR, WAVE TRI, TRIG FREE.
Route that LFO to AT X at 25%.
Use another track's 2BAR LFO routed to AT Y at 18%.
Set FORM AABA, EVERY 4, CONTR 20, LOCK 90.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the repeating LFO route drawing a recognizable path across each different section.

recipes.title: Rim and Air
steps: Set **88 BPM**, no melodic tracks at first.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 30, kick full, hats 12, fourth part RIM 45.
TWEAK HUMAN 28; pan modestly.
**T1:** one low note on a five-step STEP pattern.
**T2:** one chord every fourth bar with a long echo.
recipes.note: **Rule:** add no more than one event per listening pass.

recipes.title: Interlocking Koto
steps: Set **96 BPM**, E KUMOI.
**T1** and **T2:** QUAD, with DIV 1/16 and 8T respectively.
Hold OCT- on GEN and set one column MOVE DOWN every four steps, another MOVE UP every three.
Use RANGE 1 OCT in the GEN sheet.
**T4:** simple kick and shaker pattern to reveal the shifting accents.
recipes.note: **Change it:** LINK the faster QUAD row, then set DIR PEND on the slower one.

recipes.title: One-Knob Block Party
steps: Start with any beat containing bass, chords, lead, and drums.
Map PERF MACRO 1 positively to drum density and filter cutoff.
Map it positively to chord FX send and negatively to lead DROP.
Add a modest positive route to MOD DEPTH (**3.5+**).
Keep every amount small enough that MACRO 1 at maximum remains musical.
recipes.note: **Play it:** spend an entire arrangement using only MACRO 1 and the four mute keys.

recipes.title: Mosaic Telephone
steps: Put T1, T2, and T3 in QUAD with contrasting sounds.
Give them divisions 1/16, 8T, and 1/8.
Set QUAD columns to MOVE DOWN, UP, RAND, and HOLD at different EVERY values.
Use RANGE 1 OCT so the traveling notes remain related.
Leave T4 silent and listen to the voices exchange fragments.
recipes.note: **Change it:** add a kick only after the note traffic has established its own pulse.

recipes.title: Gravity Well
steps: **T1:** TURING, PROB 0; find a clear eight-note seed.
EVOLVE EVERY 1, AMOUNT 70, GRAVITY 15.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CONTRA, RHYTHM SOURCE.
FORM ABAC, EVERY 4, CONTR 45, DEVELOP 30.
Route a slow SWARM to EVOLVE amount.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** identity surviving heavy mutation, then disappearing.

recipes.title: Conditional Orchestra
steps: Give all four tracks the same four-bar phrase length.
T1 condition 1:4, T2 condition 2:4, T3 condition 3:4, T4 condition 4:4.
Make each track a different register and sound family.
Turn FORM AABA on all tracks but vary CONTR by track.
Use CHAIN FOLLOW so the orchestra changes section together.
recipes.note: **Change it:** replace one condition with !FIRST and hear the form lose symmetry.

recipes.title: Pendulum Canon
steps: Write a seven-step STEP melody on T1, DIR PEND (**3.5+**).
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON2, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT +2.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON4, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT -2.
Give each track a different note length.
Slowly pan the canon voices with independent LFOs.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the moment forward and backward passes overlap into a third melody.

recipes.title: Clockwork Garden
steps: **T1:** CONSTL with AUTO steering at a low setting.
**T2:** BOUNCE/FALL with SWARM controlling WIND.
**T3:** SERIES LOOP OFF, DIV 1/4.
**T4:** POLY /3, /5, /7 on percussive sounds rather than a drum kit.
Set PIECE 15 minutes, SHAPE ARCH, and ENTRIES 65.
recipes.note: **Rule:** do not synchronize the organic movement; synchronize only the beginning with PLAY.

recipes.title: Logic Rain
steps: Create two sparse generator rhythms on T1 and T2.
On T3 use TWEAK 2 logic combining the other tracks; audition its different combine behaviors.
Give T3 a bright droplet sound with LENGTH HIT.
Route TIDE to T1 density and a different TIDE to T2 density.
Keep T1/T2 quiet so T3 reveals the changing logical overlap.
recipes.note: **Change it:** bring the source tracks into the mix one at a time to expose the mechanism.

recipes.title: Seed Museum
steps: Pick one generator and sound; TURING on a pluck works well.
Write down eight neighboring ROLL values.
Present each seed for four bars, changing nothing else.
Note which seeds feel stable, surprising, or unfinished.
At the end, return to the first seed.
recipes.note: **Purpose:** hear how much composition lives in the seed rather than the controls.

recipes.title: Machine That Dreams of Silence
steps: Build four busy generator tracks, then lower all MIXER levels.
Set ENTRIES high with roles BASS, RHYTHM, HARMONY, and MELODY.
On each track add different DROP amounts between 40 and 80.
Set PIECE 10 minutes, SHAPE FALL, END STOP.
Start with the full mix, then let PIECE and ENTRIES dismantle it.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the last surviving event. Save a second version where that track has a different role.

recipes.title: One Key, Whole Sky
steps: Set **128 BPM**, root E, major scale.
**T2:** choose a bright pad or keys sound, GEN **CHORD**, PROG USER. Enter E–A–C♯m–B, BARS 1, HIT BEAT, open voicing.
Hold OCT- on GEN and set STRUM around 25 ms (**3.5+**).
**T1:** SERIES, LOOP 8, INTV 1, DIV 1/8, QNT CHRD, with a light pluck.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 45 with kick full and hats near 30.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute T1 and jam on the chord track's keys; one key supplies the whole harmony.

recipes.title: Coral Morning
steps: Set **130 BPM**, A major.
**T2:** CHORD USER with A–E–F♯m–D, HIT HOLD, BARS 1, STRUM 40 ms.
**T1:** MARKOV DENS 38, LEAP 12, QNT CHRD.
**T3:** FOLLOW T2, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN, using offbeat notes.
Keep drums light: kick each beat, clap on 2 and 4, sparse hats.
recipes.note: **Change it:** halve the tempo to 65 BPM without changing the pattern for a floating version.

recipes.title: Glass Chord Fountain
steps: Set **124 BPM**, E major pentatonic.
**T1:** GLASS PAD, CHORD PROG POP, BARS 1, HIT BEAT, open voicing.
Route a 4BAR triangle LFO to cutoff and a slower TIDE to FX send.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CHORD, RHYTHM OWN, using EUCLID with low density.
Pan T1/T2 apart and give T2 more echo.
recipes.note: **Play it:** hold one chord for four bars, then let PROG resume.

recipes.title: Major-Key Drift
steps: Set **126 BPM**, A major.
**T2:** CHORD WALK, BARS 2, HIT HOLD, seventh chords.
EVOLVE EVERY 8, AMOUNT 20, GRAVITY 70.
**T1:** CONSTL DENS 35, LEN 8, LOCK 80, QNT CHRD.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 36 with HUMAN 12.
recipes.note: **Change it:** use PIECE 8 minutes, SHAPE ARCH, END LOOP.

recipes.title: Two-Handed Sunburst
steps: Set **132 BPM**, E major.
**T2:** CHORD USER, four roots, HIT BEAT, STRUM 15 ms.
**T1:** an ARP at DIV 1/16, ORDER UP/DOWN, QNT CHRD.
**T3:** bass follower with HOW BASS, RHYTHM SOURCE.
Map PERF 1 to chord cutoff, arp FX send, and drum density.
recipes.note: **Play it:** left hand changes chord keys; right hand moves PERF 1.

recipes.title: Open-Voicing Highway
steps: Set **120 BPM**, D major.
**T2:** CHORD PROG CIRCLE, BARS 2, HIT HOLD, VOIC OPEN.
**T1:** SERIES LOOP OFF, INTV 2, DIV 1/8, QNT CHRD.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON2, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 60.
Use a straight, quiet drum pattern with an open hat on offbeats.
recipes.note: **Change it:** switch the chord sound from pad to short keys without changing anything else.

recipes.title: Chords Through Rain
steps: Set **64 BPM**, E major.
**T2:** CHORD USER with E–B–A–B, BARS 2, HIT HOLD.
**T1:** BOUNCE/FALL, SPEED 10, LENGTH HIT, QNT CHRD.
Route SWARM to WIND and TIDE to chord cutoff.
Add only a soft kick on beats 1 and 3.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** falling notes that briefly color the held major chords.

recipes.title: Four Chords, Many Rooms
steps: Set **128 BPM**, any major key.
**T2:** enter a four-chord USER progression, BARS 1.
FORM AABA, EVERY 4, CONTR 20 on T1 and T4, but leave T2 unchanged.
**T1:** TURING PROB 3, DIV 1/8, QNT CHRD.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 50, with section contrast controlled by FORM.
recipes.note: **Change it:** the harmony stays familiar while melody and drums create the rooms.

recipes.title: Bright Hands, Slow Echo
steps: Set **130 BPM**, A major.
**T2:** short CHORD stabs on every beat, STRUM 30 ms.
Add ECHO with a low mix and long-feeling feedback.
**T1:** MARKOV DENS 25, LEAP 20, QNT CHRD, no echo.
**T4:** dry kick and clap; keep hats below 25.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute the chord sound after one stab and let the echo carry the progression.

recipes.title: Chord Jam Without Drums
steps: Set **125 BPM**, E major, but leave T4 silent.
**T2:** CHORD USER, HIT BEAT, open seventh voicing.
**T1:** POLY with /3, /4, and /5, SPAN 1, QNT CHRD.
**T3:** bass follower on beats 1 and 3 only.
Route a synced LFO to T1 pan and T2 FX send.
recipes.note: **Play it:** let the chord attacks define the beat; add drums only if the pulse is unclear.

recipes.title: Pocket Overworld
steps: Set **150 BPM**, C major pentatonic.
**T1:** choose a bright, simple sound; SERIES LOOP 8, INTV 1, DIV 1/16.
**T2:** CHORD USER with C–F–Am–G, short HIT length.
**T3:** FOLLOW T2, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN, with short 1/8 notes.
**T4:** dry STEP drums with a small kick, snare, and rapid hats.
recipes.note: **Change it:** use FORM AABA on T1 for a tiny overworld theme.

recipes.title: One-Channel Chords
steps: Set **140 BPM**, A minor.
**T1:** ARP at DIV 1/16 or faster, ORDER UP, short fixed notes.
**T2:** CHORD USER with Am–F–C–G, muted in the MIXER but still leading harmony.
Set T1 QNT CHRD so the fast notes spell each muted chord.
Add no reverb; keep the illusion dry and direct.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** a full chord implied by one rapidly shared voice.

recipes.title: Boss Room Countdown
steps: Set **165 BPM**, E minor.
**T1:** TURING, PROB 0, LEN 7, DIV 1/16, narrow range.
**T2:** POLY with /3 and /4, using a low metallic sound.
**T4:** kick each beat, snare on 2 and 4, ratcheted hats.
FORM ABAC, EVERY 4, CONTR 35; use DEVELOP 15.
recipes.note: **Drop:** silence everything for the last two steps, then restart with GLO + PLAY.

recipes.title: Save-Point Glow
steps: Set **90 BPM**, D major.
**T1:** CONSTL DENS 20, SIZE 2, LEN 4, LOCK 90.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE, open voicing, HIT HOLD.
Use short digital-sounding tones with a small echo.
Route a slow square LFO to T1 pan for simple left/right motion.
recipes.note: **Change it:** shift CONSTL Y upward when the player is fully healed.

recipes.title: Tracker Staircase
steps: Set **145 BPM**, E minor pentatonic.
Write a four-note STEP pattern and set Accumulate +1 on its first note.
Set Accum limit 7 and mode PING.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, SHIFT -7, DROP 40, with a bass sound.
**T4:** a rigid four-bar drum loop with no HUMAN.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the melody climbing like a tracker transpose command.

recipes.title: Eight-Bit Airship
steps: Set **138 BPM**, G major.
**T1:** SERIES LOOP 8, INTV 3, DIV 1/8.
**T2:** ARP at DIV 1/16, QNT CHRD, quieter than T1.
**T3:** CHORD WALK, BARS 2, short notes, open voicing.
Use POLY percussion instead of a realistic kit.
recipes.note: **Change it:** raise T1 one octave in section B.

recipes.title: Dungeon Torch
steps: Set **112 BPM**, C minor.
**T1:** TURING PROB 2, LEN 5, low octave, DIV 1/8.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE, minor seventh, HIT HOLD, level low.
**T3:** BOUNCE/FALL, SPEED 14, narrow scale.
Use one dry kick every two beats and a rim every fourth bar.
recipes.note: **Rule:** keep the note range small; tension comes from repetition.

recipes.title: Final Cartridge
steps: Set **172 BPM**, D minor.
**T1:** CONSTL DENS 75, SPEED 1/16, LEN 8, LOCK 65, FILL ARP.
**T2:** CHORD USER, one chord per bar, short STRUM.
**T3:** bass follower with a 1/16 EUCLID rhythm.
**T4:** maximum-energy STEP drums with conditioned fills every fourth bar.
recipes.note: **Play it:** assign PERF 1 to lead octave feel, drum density, and echo send for the final phase.

recipes.title: Red Warning Screen
steps: Set **132 BPM**, E minor.
**T1:** TURING, LEN 5, PROB 0, DIV 1/16, using a hard short sound.
**T2:** POLY /3 against /4 with metallic tones.
**T3:** low CHORD DRONE, minor chord, FILTER cutoff slowly rising.
**T4:** rigid kick and tom pattern; condition the heaviest toms to 4:4.
recipes.note: **Build:** route one PERF macro to cutoff, MOD DEPTH, and drum density.

recipes.title: Concrete Megacity
steps: Set **118 BPM**, C minor.
**T4:** ATLAS DENS 62, kick full, snare low, fourth part RIM.
Route a 4BAR LFO to AT X and a 2BAR LFO to AT Y.
**T1:** SERIES LOOP OFF, INTV 1, DIV 1/8, low metallic sound.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE through FILTER and ECHO, very quiet.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the drum map shifting like traffic viewed from above.

recipes.title: Empty Train Platform
steps: Set **58 BPM**, A minor pentatonic.
Record a sparse STEP melody on a piano-like sound.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON4, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 35.
**T3:** STRING MACH, CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD.
Give T2 more echo than T1 and leave drums out.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute T1 after one pass so only its delayed memory remains.

recipes.title: Bio-Mechanical Pulse
steps: Set **136 BPM**, D Phrygian-like or minor scale.
**T1:** AWAKE with alternating A/B states, DIV 1/16.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CONTRA, RHYTHM SOURCE.
**T4:** STEP drums with kicks on uneven gaps and ratcheted toms.
FORM ABAC, EVERY 4, CONTR 45 on T1 and drums.
recipes.note: **Change it:** MOD DEPTH at zero freezes the machine; raise it slowly.

recipes.title: Rooftop Before the Storm
steps: Set **72 BPM**, E major.
**T1:** SERIES LOOP 8, INTV 2, DIV 1/8, light bell sound.
**T2:** CHORD USER with E–C♯m–A–B, HIT HOLD.
**T3:** BOUNCE/FALL, SPEED 8, LENGTH HIT, QNT CHRD.
Route TIDE to pad cutoff and SWARM to the falling line's pan.
recipes.note: **Change it:** switch the scale to E minor for the scene after the storm arrives.

recipes.title: Opening Credits Sprint
steps: Set **158 BPM**, G major.
**T1:** SERIES LOOP 8, INTV 3, DIV 1/8.
**T2:** CHORD USER, G–D–Em–C, HIT BEAT, STRUM 20 ms.
**T3:** bass follower on fast offbeats.
**T4:** kick, snare, and open hats with a fill every fourth bar.
recipes.note: **Arrange it:** AABA for 16 bars, breakdown for 8, then ABAC with T1 an octave up.

recipes.title: Psychic Static
steps: Set **100 BPM**, chromatic-feeling minor scale.
**T1:** CONSTL DENS 65, SIZE 4, LEN 4, LOCK 25.
Route SWARM to C Y and DRIFT to FILTER cutoff.
**T2:** low POLY /5 and /7, long notes.
**T4:** sparse industrial hits with large empty gaps.
recipes.note: **Rule:** keep the bass stable while the upper voice loses its center.

recipes.title: End-Credits Photograph
steps: Set **66 BPM**, C major pentatonic.
**T1:** a soft keys sound, TURING PROB 0, DIV 1/8.
EVOLVE EVERY 8, AMOUNT 15, GRAVITY 85.
**T2:** CHORD WALK, BARS 4, HIT HOLD, open voicing.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CHORD, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 70.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** tiny melody changes that feel like different photographs of the same day.

recipes.title: Rain on the Headband
steps: Set **62 BPM**, D minor pentatonic.
**T1:** choose FLUTE, SERIES LOOP 8, INTV 1, DIV 1/4, LENGTH HIT.
**T2:** STRING MACH, CHORD DRONE, HIT HOLD, level low.
Route TIDE to T2 cutoff and a small SWARM amount to flute pan.
Add one soft hand-drum-like hit on beats 1 and 3.
recipes.note: **Play it:** leave a full bar of silence after every second flute phrase.

recipes.title: Hidden Leaf Morning
steps: Set **92 BPM**, G major pentatonic.
**T1:** FLUTE, CONSTL DENS 35, SIZE 2, LEN 8, LOCK 85.
**T2:** KOTO WARM, CHORD USER with G–C–Em–D, HIT BEAT.
**T3:** FOLLOW T2, HOW BASS, RHYTHM OWN, sparse notes.
**T4:** light kick, rim, and shaker pattern with HUMAN 18.
recipes.note: **Change it:** raise CONSTL Y for a brighter village variation.

recipes.title: Path Through Cedars
steps: Set **76 BPM**, E KUMOI.
**T1:** FLUTE, BOUNCE/FALL, SPEED 12, WIND near center.
**T2:** KOTO WARM, TURING PROB 0, DIV 1/8, narrow range.
**T3:** CHORD DRONE, open fifth-like voicing, HIT HOLD.
Route SWARM to flute WIND and TIDE to drone level.
recipes.note: **Listen for:** the flute and koto accidentally answering each other.

recipes.title: Training Ground
steps: Set **118 BPM**, A minor pentatonic.
**T1:** FLUTE, TURING PROB 4, DIV 1/8, short notes.
**T2:** KOTO WARM, FOLLOW T1, SHIFT +2, DROP 45.
**T3:** low SERIES LOOP 4, INTV 1.
**T4:** dry tom and rim groove with a conditioned 4:4 fill.
recipes.note: **Change it:** FORM AABA with CONTR 25 turns the exercise into a scene.

recipes.title: Moon Over the Dojo
steps: Set **55 BPM**, A minor.
**T1:** FLUTE, MARKOV DENS 20, LEAP 12, LENGTH HIT.
**T2:** CHORD DRONE, minor seventh, open voicing.
**T3:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON4, RHYTHM SOURCE, DROP 55.
Pan the canon away from the lead and give it a longer echo.
recipes.note: **Rule:** never let more than two voices speak at once.

recipes.title: Messenger Hawk
steps: Set **104 BPM**, D major pentatonic.
**T1:** FLUTE, SERIES LOOP OFF, INTV 3, DIV 1/8.
**T2:** CHORD WALK, BARS 2, HIT HOLD; set T1 QNT CHRD.
**T3:** POLY /3 and /5 on short wooden sounds.
**T4:** sparse kick and shaker, with no heavy snare.
recipes.note: **Change it:** shift T1 up an octave when the message reaches its destination.

recipes.title: Names on the Memorial Stone
steps: Set **48 BPM**, E minor pentatonic.
Record a five-note flute phrase into STEP with long gaps.
**T2:** FOLLOW T1, HOW CANON8, RHYTHM SOURCE, SHIFT -2.
**T3:** low CHORD DRONE through FILTER, barely audible.
Use PIECE 6 minutes, SHAPE FALL, END STOP.
recipes.note: **Play it:** begin with the follower muted; bring it in only for the final two minutes.

recipes.title: Festival Lantern Run
steps: Set **126 BPM**, C major pentatonic.
**T1:** FLUTE, CONSTL DENS 58, LEN 8, LOCK 75, FILL ARP.
**T2:** KOTO WARM, CHORD USER with C–F–Am–G, short STRUM.
**T3:** bass follower with offbeat rhythm.
**T4:** lively ATLAS groove, fourth part RIM, HUMAN 12.
recipes.note: **Play it:** mute drums for four bars, then return with FILL held for the last beat.
